turns.content: For a qPCR standard curve at 100% efficiency, how should Ct change with starting copy number, and what shift is expected for a tenfold dilution?

Calculate the mean Ct for standards of 100000, 10000, 1000, 100, and 10 copies per microlitre from the triplicates (33.9,34.2,34.5), (30.6,30.9,31.2), (27.3,27.6,27.9), (24.0,24.3,24.6), and (20.7,21.0,21.3).
Are adjacent tenfold standards separated by the interval expected from 100% efficiency and a slope of -3.3?
Separately assess the direction of the copy-number/Ct trend and the precision within each triplicate. Treat 0.3 Ct as the allowed deviation from a concentration mean, not as the full range.
Describe a diagnostic sequence that checks spacing, trend direction, and replicate precision independently.
Apply that sequence to identify the principal discrepancy, then state whether the spacing, replicate precision, or qPCR method itself is at fault.
What is the main inconsistency in the calibration series, and how do the mean Ct values demonstrate it?
Does any supplied efficiency, slope, fit, concentration, Ct, or replicate-threshold evidence change that diagnosis?
